Description: Build a competitive intelligence cockpit for Almirall's dermatology franchise. A Databricks App (FastAPI + React SPA) that visualizes pharma landscape data from Unity Catalog and provides AI-powered research via streaming chat, voice interaction, and an interactive 3D globe.

As a developer, I want a well-structured backend with a data adapter layer so that the frontend can consume competitive intelligence data from Unity Catalog via REST endpoints.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Monorepo with three Python service packages (memory, harness, runtime)
- Memory Service exposes 12+ GET endpoints reading from Platinum tables
- Runtime library provides config management, LLM factory, and prompt caching
- Dev launcher (run.py) starts all services with colored output

As a user, I want to interact with an AI agent via text and voice, receive streaming responses, and get a daily pharma news briefing so that I can research the competitive landscape hands-free.

Acceptance Criteria:
- LangGraph agent with tools (wiki search, map control, deep research)
- SSE streaming endpoint with structured event types
- Full voice pipeline: push-to-talk STT, agent turn, TTS playback
- News RSS aggregation from 24+ pharma feeds with 24h caching
- Vera proxy endpoint forwarding to Databricks Model Serving

As an Almirall analyst, I want an interactive cockpit with a 3D globe, radial drug chart, and knowledge graph so that I can visually explore the competitive landscape and drill into any entity.

Acceptance Criteria:
- React 19 SPA with Vite 6, dark/light theme, glassmorphism design system
- Dashboard: MapLibre globe with competitor pins + Three.js hologram shader
- Bullseye: SVG radial chart with 47 drugs across AD/HS/PSO + timeline slider
- Knowledge Graph: hand-rolled force simulation, SVG rendering, flashcards on click

As a user, I want to chat with the AI agent via text and voice directly in the cockpit, and as a DevOps engineer I want the app deployed on Databricks with automated data refresh so that the platform is production-ready.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Chat UI with SSE streaming, typewriter effect, tool call visualization
- Voice agent: AudioWorklet capture, WebSocket STT, TTS playback via AudioContext
- Landing page with product showcase and animated transitions
- Databricks App deployment with DABs bundle and daily Lakeflow Job

Summary: Monorepo scaffolding runtime library & dev tooling
Description:
- pyproject.toml with hatchling build (3 packages: atlas_memory, atlas_harness, atlas_runtime)
- Runtime: env/config loader, LLM factory (Gemini cloud + Ollama local), Gemini context-cache helper
- scripts/run.py multi-process dev launcher (memory + harness + Vite)
- run.ps1 / stop.ps1 convenience scripts
- pytest config, ruff/mypy setup

Summary: Memory Service — Unity Catalog REST adapter
Description:
- FastAPI app on port 8001 with databricks-sql-connector
- Endpoints: /graph, /bullseye, /news, /kols, /trials, /node/{id}
- Tenant-scoped brain routes: /tenant/{id}/brain/{brain_id}/hot|index|graph|page|search
- Pydantic response schemas for all endpoints
- SQL queries against platinum_* tables (nodes, edges, bullseye, news_events, kols, trials)

Summary: LangGraph chat agent + SSE streaming + deep research
Description:
- create_deep_agent() with AsyncSqliteSaver checkpointer
- Tools: search_wiki, read_page, fly_to_location, show_route, clear_map
- SSE event types: meta, tool, tool_done, tool_progress, token, done, error
- Deep research pipeline: supervisor -> parallel sub-agents -> compression -> synthesis
- SQLite run store, per-turn budget enforcement, query classifier

- WebSocket /voice/stream/stt — streaming STT via Gemini Live API
- POST /voice/turn — multipart audio in, SSE response with text + audio frames
- TTS via gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview, sentence-splitting for low-latency first audio
- Pre-rendered PCM cache for cue phrases, language detection (EN/ES/CA)
- Client tool bridge (agent -> SSE -> browser executes -> HTTP result back)

Summary: News RSS aggregator & Vera proxy endpoint
Description:
- 24+ RSS feeds (pharma, derm, competitors, YouTube)
- feedparser ingestion with 24h response caching
- POST /vera/stream — proxy to Databricks MLflow ResponsesAgent endpoint
- POST /competitor-update — BioMCP trial search + deep research per company
- scripts/fetch_biomcp.py and scripts/research_competitors.py batch utilities

Summary: React SPA scaffold routing & design system
Description:
- Vite 6 + React 19 + TypeScript 5.7, react-router-dom v7
- Two-level routing: / (landing) and /app/* (cockpit shell with tabs)
- Design tokens in oklch (tokens.css), ~5000 lines cockpit CSS
- Glassmorphism header, HUD bracket frames, aurora blobs, dot-pulse animations
- View Transitions API for landing -> cockpit crossfade
- Dark/light theme via [data-theme], localStorage persistence

Summary: Dashboard — MapLibre globe Three.js hologram competitor pins
Description:
- MapLibre GL 5.x with globe projection, CARTO basemaps (theme-aware)
- 16 competitor HQ pins with custom SVG markers
- Three.js custom MapLibre layer: cyan wireframe hologram buildings with GLSL shader (scanline, fresnel, data-rain)
- OSM Overpass building footprint fetch + static JSON fallback
- Daily news panel component with expandable competitor photo cards

- Bullseye: Pure SVG radial chart, concentric phase rings, 47 drugs, color-coded by modality (mAb, small molecule, nanobody, bispecific), timeline slider (2001-2026), zoom/pan, drug dossier sidebar
- Knowledge Graph: custom force simulation (N-body repulsion, spring edges, center gravity), SVG with zoom/pan/drag, node coloring by layer, neighborhood highlighting, flashcard popover via Memory API

Summary: Chat + voice UI (SSE streaming push-to-talk typewriter)
Description:
- useStreamChat hook: ReadableStream reader, data: frame parsing, typewriter drain via requestAnimationFrame
- Tool call visualization: collapsible ToolGroup, deep-research progress steps
- useVeraChat hook: separate Vera agent (full history, no server thread)
- useVoiceTurn hook (~740 LOC): AudioWorklet mic capture at 16kHz mono, WebSocket streaming STT, TTS AudioContext playback, fly_to_location client tool execution
- Thread persistence in localStorage, research mode toggle

Summary: Landing page competitor intel cards & Databricks deployment
Description:
- Landing page: multi-section marketing with parallax, IntersectionObserver fade-ups, static bullseye snapshot, mock globe, mock graph SVG
- Competitor photo cards: Wikipedia/curated photos, therapy areas, expandable deep analysis
- app.yaml: Databricks App entry point, env vars, SQL Warehouse resource binding
- databricks.yml: DABs bundle with dev/tst/prod targets, React SPA artifact upload
- Lakeflow Job: refresh-platinum daily cron at 06:00 UTC
- atlas_app.py: production FastAPI serving static SPA + mounting memory/harness routers
